subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should the global Gateway channel-restart admission change remain bundled with this Matrix QA migration?
rationale: The change modifies production restart semantics for every channel, while the PR's stated scope and live proof are Matrix-specific; accepting that combined boundary requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Split Gateway lifecycle change
options.body: Move the admission change into a dedicated PR with focused plugin-reload and config-reload channel restart proof before this QA migration lands.

options.title: Keep with broader proof
options.body: Retain the change here only after adding lifecycle coverage for both restart call sites and documenting why all channels require the new admission behavior.

recommendation.title: Split Gateway lifecycle change
recommendation.body: Move the admission change into a dedicated PR with focused plugin-reload and config-reload channel restart proof before this QA migration lands.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the merged prerequisite and current Matrix QA stack, so they are best positioned to split the dependency or provide the missing lifecycle rationale and proof.
